generation.mode: single built-in image_gen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and their immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell cast-shadow field is visible, but pale terrace and column caps are consistently lighter than darker vertical faces. The literal equal-value flat-lighting rule therefore fails even though aggregate gradient directions are balanced.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent bench tops and the level shelves beside the rock rises count as buildable; exposed bench and column faces count as steep; talus, scree, broken edges, streams, rune carving and vegetation make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: This is a screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame manual outer-foliage census at native 1254 px of all 33 visually distinguishable conifer crowns, including saplings, clipped edge crowns and readable individuals in overlaps; median source width 26 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank polygon and rounded-channel trace of every visible teal surface, ripple, reflection, pale fall, spray, splash and edge wash; the full mask overlay was inspected over the raw source.

runeChain.visualRead: The dark floor remains continuous and dry with stone rims, but the regular rim treatment can still read as a lined trench or kerb rather than an unequivocal slot removed two metres into bedrock.

reviewFindings.finding: The strict neutral-lighting gate fails: pale rock caps and upper planes remain visibly lighter than vertical faces.
The eastern top-bench wind arch does not carry the rune groove; a different smaller arch farther west carries it.
The plateau tarn is approximately 13.2 metres across at the stated cell scale, materially below the requested approximately 30 metres.
The wind-arch opening is approximately 8.4 metres across rather than approximately 12 metres.
Several bench walls remain regular repeated column rows, and the rune rims can read as constructed stone edging rather than an ancient excavated slot.

positiveObservations: The result is one square whole-canvas edit with no remaining grey authoring area, crop, resize, tiling or patch ring.
Neighbour ground continues through all four edges and transitions inward before the pale bare plateau dominates.
The thin fall is south of and separate from the rune groove, and no classified water occupies the rune line.
The measured conifer crown median is inside the required 1.7-to-5.2-metre band.
